definitions: A thing that is granted, especially in response to demands.
A preferential right or privilege granted by a government or company to another entity.
A point yielded in an argument or debate.
A small business or stand, especially one selling food or drink.
examples: The government made a concession to the protesters.
They operate a mining concession in the region.
He made a concession that his opponent had a valid point.
We bought popcorn at the concession stand.
